brandThesis: Official Pokémon TCG communicates through sharply separated page-purpose systems rather than one universal skin: campaign pages use a black cinematic stage and authentic collectible art; the database uses a restrained light title plate around a dense charcoal search organism; learning pages use oversized instructional hierarchy, authentic cards and diagrams, and painted yellow/navy section boundaries.

invariants.rule: Color belongs to a page or section role and must not be promoted into a freely interchangeable global palette.
When a campaign, result, or lesson concerns cards, independent official card/product assets carry the subject identity; screenshots never do.
Phone layouts may stack, repeat explanatory visuals, or reduce columns, but retain section order, asset weight, and control truth.
Long pages remain a sequence of visually bounded organisms; item count is not an acceptable proxy for section structure.

colorRoles.observedValue: white/off-white with pale texture in results
forbiddenRoles: claiming a flat untextured result background

colorRoles.observedValue: warm yellow paint edge / pale cream field

observed.rule: Use a readable rounded sans for database labels and controls; do not infer the same face for other pages.
Preserve the observed scale contrast: oversized section headings over compact instructional definitions.

forbidden: claiming exact Home/Learn font family without computed evidence
using typography alone as a substitute for section composition

density.home: Low-to-medium density campaign stage followed by large editorial/product bands; large whitespace in the captured page is not evidence to invent content.
density.cardDatabase: High control density inside one bounded search organism, then a lower-chrome authentic-card mosaic with sort and pagination.
density.learn: Long-form and high information volume, segmented into large painted instructional organisms with definition-to-visual pairing.
density.phone: Stack controls/content vertically without removing reading-order steps or converting enabled controls into decoration.

frameAndBoundary.home: Black navigation and carousel cap the hero; later modules are separate bands or alternating square grids.
frameAndBoundary.cardDatabase: Light clipped/angled title plate, charcoal form field, grey drawer tab, then light textured result mosaic.
frameAndBoundary.learn: Painted irregular yellow and navy edges visibly announce topic changes; these boundaries belong only to the observed instructional organisms.
forbidden: flattening every section into generic cards

homeCarousel.semantics: Next changes slide pixels and can restore the initial slide/scroll state; unchanged H1 is not proof of no change.

sequence: results settled with Search Results and 1/12

learnAccordion.semantics: Exclusive open panel changes and restores; phone may pair each definition with its repeated card visual.

reduceMotion.observed: No visible, body-class, aria-pressed, text, or computed-style change after two clicks.
reduceMotion.implementationRule: Do not invent a toggle state, animation suppression effect, or pressed styling.

assetUsage.use: Home campaign stage only, as stage art with observed desktop/phone crop translation.
Home campaign identity layer paired with its campaign stage.
Full collectible proof layer overlapping/below the campaign identity depending on viewport.
Overlapping transparent product-ecosystem composition in the TCGL band.
Alternating square editorial grid; full-width squares on phone.
Right-aligned partial fan in the learning hero; cropped top band on phone.
Full card for anatomy/hotspot explanation; repeat alongside phone definitions when preserving pairing.
Matching diagram variant beside its field-location definition; definition/diagram pairs on phone.
Authentic full-card result assets in the Pikachu result mosaic.

patterns.meaning: A black campaign stage establishes one dominant campaign through separate navigation, campaign art, identity, CTA, collectible and carousel-control layers.
patterns.usage: Home campaign entry only; preserve the independent layers and evidenced desktop-to-phone reading order.

patterns.meaning: Discrete editorial, ecosystem and alternating image/copy bands move Home from campaign to discovery.
patterns.usage: Home editorial and product-ecosystem sections; collapse columns without flattening distinct organisms.

patterns.meaning: A dense query task is bounded inside charcoal between a light title plate and explicit reset, search and drawer controls.
patterns.usage: Card-database query construction; retain control order and state truth when stacked on phone.

patterns.meaning: Results and advanced filters are disclosed through separate reversible state machines rather than presented as static decoration.
patterns.usage: The evidenced Pikachu search and advanced-filter flows only.

patterns.meaning: A partial card fan and oversized hierarchy lead into a 16:9 starter-media blade and learning resources.
patterns.usage: How to Play entry only, preserving media identity and phone order.

patterns.meaning: A warm painted field binds exclusive definitions and hotspots to one authentic full card.
patterns.usage: Card-anatomy instruction only; retain definition/card proximity on phone.

patterns.meaning: A navy painted field teaches play locations through ordered definition-to-diagram pairs.
patterns.usage: Field-of-play instruction only; preserve exact definition/diagram pairing through reflow.

patterns.meaning: Across Home, Card Database and Learn, long pages preserve purpose-specific organisms and their reading order instead of using item count as a structure proxy.
patterns.usage: Held-out structural proof only: use at least two source-independent organisms with distinct purposes and an explicit entry-to-instruction order.
notFor: claiming section count alone as fidelity

patterns.meaning: The Championship section is a transparent equal-weight editorial/image pair on the continuous white Home canvas; desktop is copy-left/image-right and phone is image-first.
patterns.usage: One event story with one exact official square image, one heading, one paragraph and one outbound CTA.

patterns.meaning: Centered Kanit heading, PT Sans body and PT Sans CTA preserve distinct editorial roles at the two frozen endpoints.
patterns.usage: At 1440 use h2/body/CTA 48/18/18px; at 390 use 32/18/18px with frozen line heights. Values are section-local.

styleRecipeDetails.meaning: Campaign black, database charcoal/light texture, learning yellow paint and learning navy paint identify different page purposes rather than one interchangeable skin.
styleRecipeDetails.usage: Select boundaries by evidenced page purpose and preserve their ownership and information density.

styleRecipeDetails.meaning: The Championship CTA uses a near-black default surface, a mandatory 2px inset frame and the frozen separation shadow.
styleRecipeDetails.usage: Championship Series outbound CTA only, together with its approved interaction recipe.

interactionRecipes.purpose: Change slide pixels and restore the initial slide state.
Preserve empty, typed, settled-results and restored-empty states.
Reveal and restore filters while changing the label and preserving observed intermediate and settled heights.
Keep one card-definition panel open and permit restoration while retaining card proximity.
Pointer hover reveals full gold; keyboard focus remains near-black with a visible outline.
interactionRecipes.usage: Championship Series Learn more CTA only, preserving its verified destination.

interactionRecipes.purpose: No behavior may be prescribed until an observable effect is captured.
interactionRecipes.usage: Keep unresolved; return to Brand Researcher if required.

No computed font-family evidence was supplied for these page regions.
Most roles are screenshot-supported but lack computed color values; preserve roles and visible relationships, not invented hex precision.
